content.text:
**Finding: compliant** — no exclusivity obligation binds AP.

- **Section 1 (Kubient Services, p0001)** contains an express anti-exclusivity statement: "Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties." This satisfies the preferred position outright.
- Other "exclusive"/"sole" hits are benign: a non-exclusive license granted **to us** (p0002), exclusive jurisdiction/venue (p0064), each party's own trademark ownership (p0065), and no-third-party-beneficiary language (p0073).
- No requirements-purchase, sole-provider, preferred-partner or "shall not procure from any third party" language appears anywhere in the agreement.

No redline proposed.
